profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at American Express
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience in Web Software Development. Proven skills with Operating Systems, Software Development, Programming Languages and Databases. Team Player with initiative.

positions.title: Sales Account Manager
positions.description:
·   Manage client account database, build and maintain client relationships.
   ·   Research risk and viability of entering U.S. EDI market through online and telemarketing.
   ·   Prepare quotes, proposals and technical demos for potential and new clients.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
January 2007 ­ January 2008
   ·   Developed PHP software and designed applications for the production and assembling department.
   ·   Assisted and maintained Visual Fox Pro Databases for import and foreign trade.
   ·   IT used: PHP, Javascript, CSS, HTML, MySQL, Visual Basic for Applications (MS Excel).
